units.source_text: 走了五六步，似乎还过得去。

en.t: After five or six steps, it still seemed manageable.

units.source_text: 然后，脚开始陷到沙子里面去了。

en.t: Then his feet began to sink down into the sand.

units.source_text: 这时再也分不清是进还是退了，

en.t: By then he could no longer tell whether he was moving forward or backward,

units.source_text: 渐渐地，膝盖以下全埋进沙子里，

en.t: and little by little, everything below his knees was buried in the sand,
until even his body could no longer move.

units.source_text: 他索性趴在沙壁上，冒冒失失地往上攀。

en.t: He finally threw himself against the sand wall and recklessly tried to climb upward.

units.source_text: 滚烫的沙子，把他的手掌都烧焦了。

en.t: The scorching sand burned the palms of his hands raw.
Sweat poured from his whole body,

units.source_text: 那汗上沾着沙子，弄得连眼睛都睁不开了。

en.t: and sand stuck to the sweat, making it impossible even to keep his eyes open.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，脚上的肌肉全麻木了，

en.t: Before long, all the muscles in his feet went numb,
and he could not move at all anymore.
